title: Fixing Our Focus: Training Attention to Regulate Emotion
summary: Empirical studies have frequently linked negative attentional biases with attentional dysfunction and negative moods; however, far less research has focused on how attentional deployment can be an adaptive strategy that regulates emotional experience. The authors argue that attention may be an invaluable tool for promoting emotion regulation. Accordingly, they present evidence that selective attention to positive information reflects emotion regulation and that regulating attention is a critical component of the emotion regulatory process. Furthermore, attentional regulation can be successfully trained through repeated practice. The authors ultimately propose a model of attention training methodologies integrating attention-dependent emotion regulation strategies with attention networks. Although additional interdisciplinary research is needed to bolster these nascent findings, meditative practices appear to be among the most effective training methodologies in enhancing emotional well-being. Further exploration of the positive and therapeutic qualities of attention warrants the empirical attention of social and personality psychologists.

标题：聚焦注意力：通过注意力训练调节情绪
摘要：实证研究频繁将消极注意偏向与注意功能障碍及消极情绪联系起来；然而，很少有研究关注注意部署如何作为一种适应性策略来调节情绪体验。作者认为，注意力可能是促进情绪调节的宝贵工具。据此，他们提出证据表明，对积极信息的选择性注意反映了情绪调节，而调节注意力是情绪调节过程的关键组成部分。此外，注意力调节可以通过反复练习成功训练。作者最终提出了一个注意训练方法模型，将依赖注意的情绪调节策略与注意网络相结合。尽管需要更多跨学科研究来支持这些初步发现，但冥想实践似乎是增强情绪幸福感最有效的训练方法之一。进一步探索注意力的积极品质和治疗品质值得社会与人格心理学家的实证关注。
关键词：注意力训练；情绪调节；注意偏向；冥想；情绪幸福感
